usedFor: Todoist holds tasks and Hive holds team projects, so “New Task Created in Project” can run “Create Action for Workspace”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Task Created in Project” in Todoist, then “Create Action for Workspace” in Hive
bestTemplate.why: Each new Todoist task appears in a Hive workspace with a scheduled date.

watchOut: Wiring both Todoist triggers to “Create Action for Workspace” in Hive could duplicate a task.
